name: Prompt Injection Benchmark for FM-integrated Systems (FSPIB)
description: An interactive and dynamic benchmark for evaluating prompt injection attacks and defenses in foundation model integrated systems across multiple modalities including text, code, web pages, and vision.
reputation: A recent security benchmark for prompt injection in foundation-model-integrated systems, with growing interest but limited established adoption so far.
notes: Covers diverse threat categories and modalities; features interactive environments and extensible attacks and defenses; highlights security vulnerabilities and limited defense effectiveness.
